_about: Relations backfill queue (user decision C, 2026-10-17; enrich skill section 2). Every graph company that was on the map before 2026-10-17 gets ALL its business relationships recorded, AI or not, a few per night: the nightly enrich takes the next per_night pending rows from the top (most-connected first: degree = AI edges in graph/merged_graph.json when the row was queued), writes their non-AI relationships to relations/<company>.json and their AI ones as patches, then marks them done with `python -X utf8 relations.py done "<Company>"`. ADD-only: rows are never removed or reordered and a done row never goes back to pending; `relations.py queue` appends graph companies the file does not list yet.
